title: Prompt hook
description: Sends a prompt plus the hook input to a Claude model for single-turn evaluation; the model answers `{"ok": true|false, "reason": "...", "impossible"?: bool}`. Not supported on the events listed as command/http/mcp_tool-only.

type.description: Handler type: `prompt` evaluates a prompt with an LLM.
type.title: Type

prompt.description: Prompt text. `$ARGUMENTS` is replaced by the hook input JSON (appended when absent); escape a literal dollar as `\$`.
prompt.title: Prompt

model.description: Model used for the evaluation. Defaults to a fast model (Haiku).
model.title: Model

continueOnBlock.description: On the events it applies to (PostToolUse, PreToolUse, TeammateIdle, ...), true feeds an `ok: false` reason back to Claude and continues instead of ending the turn. Default false. Prompt hooks only.
continueOnBlock.title: Continue On Block

timeout.description: Seconds before the handler is canceled. Default 30 for prompt hooks.
timeout.title: Timeout

statusMessage.description: Custom spinner message displayed while the handler runs.
statusMessage.title: Status Message

once.description: If true, the hook is removed after its first successful run (a failed, exit-2 or timed-out run keeps it). Only honored for hooks declared in skill frontmatter; ignored in settings files and agent frontmatter.
once.title: Once

if.description: Permission-rule-syntax filter (exactly one rule, e.g. `Bash(git *)`, `Edit(*.ts)`, `PowerShell(Remove-Item *)`); the handler only runs when the tool call matches. Evaluated only on PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest and PermissionDenied; on any other event a handler with `if` never runs. There is no `&&`/`||`/list syntax: use one handler per condition. Best-effort filter, not a security boundary.
if.title: If

examples.prompt: Evaluate if Claude should stop: $ARGUMENTS. Check if all tasks are complete.
